annotations.title: Verify the ContextMint Bridge connection end-to-end

description: Round-trips a small public www.etix.com URL (/robots.txt) through ContextMint Bridge (your signed-in browser tab) and returns diagnostics: the bridge's role (host/peer/null), port, version, the extension link (linked / pair pending / not attached / never answered), the elapsed round-trip time, and a plain-English hint distinguishing 'bridge never came up' from 'extension not connected' from 'this browser can't serve a capability' from 'real www.etix.com-side problem'. Read-only, no auth required. Call this when a real tool fails and you want to know which hop broke.
name: etix_healthcheck
title: Verify the ContextMint Bridge connection end-to-end
